description: Change the text or tags of a Mixpanel annotation (annotationId from list_mixpanel_annotations). Mixpanel cannot move an annotation to a new date; to fix a wrong date, delete it and create a new one. The edited row is read back. Needs the ANALYST role on the service account. 0 credits. Needs Mixpanel connected.

description.description: new annotation text; empty text is refused

name: update_mixpanel_annotation
title: Edit a Mixpanel annotation
